title: A smile or laugh during peekaboo is a 9-month social item
summary: By about 9 months, CDC says most children smile or laugh when someone plays peekaboo with them.
body: Social milestones at 9 months include smiling or laughing when you play peek-a-boo. The game hides a face and brings it back, and the item is the baby's pleased reaction, not a duty to own one particular song. CDC counts a milestone when about three quarters of children do it. A missing reaction is not, on this page, a diagnosis. The month comes from the United States checklist.
